description: The whole market in one call. view: changes (default: what changed since your last check or since_ms, ranked by how unusual, with plain state labels, what whales net bought and sold, coins that turned unusual, biggest movers, forced closes, the market news read; pass back next_since_ms on a timer), overview (totals, whale net flow, top coins; pass coin for one row), movers (24h gainers and losers with volume), extremes (pairs at a record or their own top or bottom 5% for funding, open interest or liquidations), defi (DEX volume and TVL per chain).

coin.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC. A pair like ETH/USD works too.

cursor.description: Next page: the cursor from the previous answer.

detail.description: brief (default): the answer, key numbers and top rows. full: every row, paged with cursor.

limit.description: Rows to return (usually up to 50; more is clamped and said).

since_ms.description: changes only: only changes after this Unix-ms time. Omit for everything since your last check.

name: market_now

access_note.description: What this connection could not return.

available.description: False: no data; note says why.

title: Market now: what changed
